meta.face: A woman of about fifty-five with a pale, fine-boned, slightly long face, a small dark thorn-mark in the middle of the forehead kept small and neat, dark-brown eyes lifted in sorrowful love to the crucifix, a slender straight nose and gentle, closed lips.
meta.basis: The portrait on the casket made for her body in 1457 shows a long, pale, older face with the forehead wound; the wound, the rose and the crucifix are her constant marks. The black habit follows the popular devotional image rather than the brown of her monastery.
